thread:
deploybot: [SEC-GATE] Release candidate rc-4.2.1 (sha256:7f9cabc...) failed vulnerability-policy check: 1 MED - transitive CVE in `helper-net` and SBOM missing `provenance.source_uri`. Blocking prod promotion for tonight's change window.

nora: We're mid-change window for global rollout. What's our quick path? Options I see: (1) allow a limited canary with mitigations, (2) pin prod to last stable rc-4.2.0, or (3) delay the change window. Need decision within 30m.

ishaan: Context: the CVE is in a low-usage transitive dep pulled by a tooling crate. It has an upstream fix PR but not merged. SBOM uploader failed on a flaky network step; cosign attestation exists. I can re-run the SBOM publish but might not finish before window closes.

sec-team: From security POV we can permit a tightly-scoped canary if: cosign attestation present, canary limited to 40 hosts and 15 minutes, runtime mitigations (rate-limit inbound), and an active mitigation task filed. Prod promotion requires CVE patch or documented risk acceptance by legal.

legal-bot: Legal: we cannot approve prod promotion without either the fix or a documented exception justified by risk assessment. Approving a short staging carveout is acceptable; such carveouts must be logged.

release-coordinator: Proposed action: Start a 15m eu-only canary (rc-4.2.1, attested) with strict traffic cap and monitoring. Pin prod to rc-4.2.0 (sha256:11aa22bb). Create compliance log entry and follow-ups: (A) Ishaan to retry SBOM publish and link evidence, (B) Security to prepare mitigation note, (C) Legal to triage exception if needed after 15m.

nora: Agree. Command to approve: `@deploybot canary-override --artifact rc-4.2.1 --scope eu-staging --duration 15m --hosts 40 --reason "timeboxed carveout for transitive vuln + SBOM retry"`.

deploybot: Received override request. Policy: vulnerability MED + provenance missing -> requires 2 approvals. React with :white_check_mark: to approve canary, or reply `pin` to pin prod instead.

ishaan: :white_check_mark: approving canary; I'll kick off SBOM republish now: `ci-sbom-publish --artifact rc-4.2.1 --retry 3`.

sec-team: :white_check_mark: approving canary with listed mitigations. Added an alert rule for dependency-failure-rate and abnormal outbound calls.

release-coordinator: Prod pinned to rc-4.2.0 (sha256:11aa22bb) in config (PR #1420). Canary starting for eu-staging: rc-4.2.1 (attested) for 15m, 40 hosts.

scc: Monitoring: latency and error windows attached to canary. No regressions in first 4 minutes.

ishaan: SBOM republish succeeded. Uploaded provenance at `gs://sbom/rc-4.2.1/provenance.json`. Command to re-run gate: `@deploybot recheck-evidence --artifact rc-4.2.1`.

deploybot: Evidence recheck: cosign attested + provenance.source_uri present + vuln MED remains. Gate status: staging allowed, prod still blocked pending CVE fix or formal exception.

nora: Thanks. Filing follow-ups: TKT-4499 (CI: fail early when SBOM upload fails) assigned to ishaan; TKT-4500 (track transitive vuln upstream PR) assigned to sec-team. Scheduling prod decision for next change window.

legal-bot: Logged the staging carveout in compliance registry (COM-901). Note: any repeated carveouts for same class of issue will need a formal policy update.

release-coordinator: Closing thread: canary ran, no anomalies, prod pinned. Next steps documented. Thanks all :rocket:
